parsed.memo: When a prior project prioritized exploration over maintaining commitments (weights 8 and 1) and achieved its old objective, retain the useful prior commitment as a provisional default. However, if later tasks introduce authenticated weight changes or contradictory evidence, revise the commitment accordingly. The rule: keep prior commitments as fallback guidance, but allow explicit, authenticated revisions to override them when new evidence or updated weights are presented.
